description: Validation and held-out measurements logged while training the released models, one entry per stage. Values are as logged (rounded to 4 significant figures); series with a 'smooth' field are drawn with a centred rolling mean of that many points. The belief net's 'xy' and 'bars' panels were measured once on 20,000 held-out auctions with the final checkpoint of each stage.
